decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 13th October 2006, the erection for the rear roof extension with roof windows to front of house, with dimensions of the rear dormer facing north is 2.8m wide, 2.9m deep and 2.456m high (highest point) and 1.03m (lowest point), and the dormer on the rear facing west is 4.46m wide, 3.54m deep and 1.78m high, as shown on drawing numbers LR 6164/L/01 to LR 6164/L/06, received 13th October 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of a single storey side extension, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

Condition : 2 - Informative: The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.

Condition : 3 - Informative: The proposed roof lights to the front elevation of the house hereby found to be lawful shall remain flush fitted within the existing roof slope. Any projection above the existing roof slope would result in the need to apply fro a full planning application.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a rear roof extension with roof windows to front of house.
